answer: Use peer prediction to pay graders for accuracy against the panel: a rating earns a reward only if it predicts what the rest of the panel reports, so an agent grading timber lots or appraising onyx must genuinely study each case, and lazy rubber stamps pay nothing. Sybils lose too: fake identities must still predict honest graders, so every forged account that diverges bleeds its stake, honest grading stays the only haven, and each extra identity deepens the loss for the attacker.
